pages.summary: Robin reconoce el elefante de su programa. Hermione entrega a Jane su perfume favorito y a Malcolm una nueva pala.

panels.scene: Jane presents a wrapped package to Robin on Hermione's supported lap by the tree. The baby pats the paper with tiny natural hands, burgundy gold-thread sweater and curls clear.
panels.caption: El último regalo de Jane era para Robin.

panels.scene: Hermione has opened one corner of wrapping and lifts out one blue stuffed elephant, recognizably the same little cartoon animal from the television, three-dimensional toy with soft fabric ears.
panels.caption: Era el elefante de su programa favorito.

panels.scene: Robin now hugs the blue plush elephant while sitting securely with Pansy on rug. The HUMAN baby's face, fingers and skin are separate from the blue fabric toy. Malcolm smiles in the armchair behind them.
dialogue: Malcolm: Creo que le gustó.

panels.scene: Jane opens Hermione's small golden-paper package, recognizes the clear perfume bottle and smiles, small pale amber liquid and dark cap, no printed words.
dialogue: Jane: Pensé que ya no lo fabricaban.

panels.scene: Hermione at LEFT smiles to her mother at RIGHT, Jane holds the same clear bottle near her own shoulder. No sprays or extra objects.
dialogue: Hermione: Tuve que buscarlo en varias tiendas. Sé que es tu favorito.

panels.scene: Malcolm opens the long fabric cover of a new dark padel paddle and tests its weight in one hand, well away from others. Jane laughs softly beside him. His big reindeer nose still glows.
dialogue: Malcolm: En cuanto se derrita la nieve, la estreno.

pages.summary: Hermione le entrega a Pansy un brazalete con tres iniciales. Pansy responde a la incertidumbre sobre el final del proyecto.

panels.scene: Hermione, a little nervous, hands the small ivory jewelry box to Pansy by the sofa. Both in their unchanged holiday sweaters. Robin with the blue elephant on a supported lap at edge.
panels.caption: Hermione guardó una caja pequeña para Pansy.

panels.scene: Large close-up of the open ivory box on Pansy's lap, one delicate white-gold chain and THREE clear little silver letter charms in order H, R, P against dark velvet. No additional letter or title.
panels.caption: H, R y P.

panels.scene: Hermione speaks gently, hands resting on her own lap, red sweater and blue pendant. Pansy's green sleeve and the box at edge.
dialogue: Hermione: Quería que tuvieras algo de los tres.

panels.scene: Hermione at LEFT finishes the thought, Pansy at RIGHT answers while meeting her eyes. The bracelet in the open box lies between them, two readable ordered balloons.
dialogue: Hermione: Algo que pudieras llevar contigo cuando termine el proyecto.

panels.scene: Pansy extends her LEFT wrist naturally toward Hermione, the white-gold bracelet held by Hermione’s two hands, no unnatural arm twist. A small sincere smile.
dialogue: Pansy: Ahora ayúdame a ponérmelo.

panels.scene: Hermione has just fastened the bracelet at Pansy's LEFT wrist. Pansy lifts it slightly into the tree light and studies its three charms. Two hands maximum per person, no extra chain.
dialogue: Pansy: Es precioso, Hermione.

pages.summary: El regalo de Pansy para Jane es un First Folio. Jane comprende el cuidado que llevó la elección.

panels.scene: Pansy gives Jane the large rectangular book-size package. Jane pulls back its black cloth and a little silver glow moves across the book cover. Malcolm and Hermione look toward it.
panels.caption: Entonces llegó el turno de Pansy.

panels.scene: Close Jane opens the old book with both hands, marveling, her mature brown-eyed face recognizable. Pansy attentive beside her, bracelet on left wrist.
dialogue: Jane: Esto no puede ser lo que creo.

panels.scene: The old book's title page under warm tree light. Exact short typography only «William Shakespeare» and «1623». Its paper cream and gently textured, plain title page without invented dense writing.
panels.caption: El First Folio de Shakespeare, publicado en 1623.

panels.scene: Jane lowers the open book carefully onto her lap and looks toward Pansy with disbelief and tenderness. The black protective cloth is folded beneath it.
dialogue: Jane: No puedo aceptar algo así.

panels.scene: Pansy answers quietly with sincere green eyes, left wrist bracelet visible at the edge of the book. Hermione watches from sofa, red sweater and sapphire.
dialogue: Pansy: Quería entregárselo a alguien capaz de entenderlo y cuidarlo.

panels.scene: Jane stands and embraces Pansy warmly, the book safely resting on the low oak table. Natural two-person hug, no extra arms. Malcolm smiles, reindeer sweater luminous.
dialogue: Jane: Gracias, Pansy.

pages.summary: El cronógrafo de Malcolm abre la conversación sobre el coche. El hechizo del maletero deja de ser un secreto.

panels.caption: El cronógrafo repetía los acabados de su automóvil.

panels.scene: Malcolm at LEFT looks up from the same watch to Pansy at RIGHT and asks with a genuinely impressed smile.
dialogue: Malcolm: ¿Cómo conseguiste esto en dos días?

panels.scene: Pansy speaks with dry composure, bracelet visible on left. Jane and Hermione smile at a distance.
dialogue: Pansy: Tomé algunas notas cuando me enseñó el auto.

panels.scene: Malcolm has fastened the chronograph on his LEFT wrist and smiles at Pansy. He speaks first at LEFT; Pansy answers at RIGHT.
dialogue: Malcolm: Creo que ya puedes llamarme Malcolm.

panels.scene: Malcolm extends the same wrist to look at the dial. Hermione beside him looks surprised. Two ordered dialogue balloons, first Malcolm left, Hermione right.
dialogue: Malcolm: Y puedes volver a conducir el Porsche.

panels.scene: Malcolm smiles toward his daughter, Pansy partly hides a grin. Hermione startled with one hand resting beside her stack of books, no extra object.
dialogue: Malcolm: Ella puede. Tú hiciste magia en el maletero.
